notes: Open/exposed states are treated as on and closed states as off. The dishwasher shows two distinct open-close cycles separated by a brief closed state. Each leaf of the two double-door upper cabinets is reported separately because they are distinct movable parts, although their exact individual timings are only separable to within a few frames.
scene_description: A first-person camera moves through a modern kitchen and records consecutive manipulations of a refrigerator, dishwasher, oven, pantry and upper cabinets, pressure cooker, rice cooker, and countertop air fryer.
